styles.label: Inked Adventure Comic

Asset type: Fantasy tabletop RPG finalist stress-test tile
Input images: Image 1 is the content and composition source only; preserve its subject, arrangement, camera, and spatial relationships, and explicitly do not inherit its grayscale rendering. Image 2 is the sole style reference; inherit only its medium, ink handling, contour language, shape simplification, detail density, color application, edge treatment, and material rendering. Do not copy Image 2's objects, layouts, lighting, palette, weather, or mood.
Style/medium: Hand-inked Western fantasy adventure comic matching Image 2 exactly: expressive variable-weight brush contours, confidently simplified believable forms, strong silhouettes, opaque natural local color, hard-edged shadow shapes, handmade ink texture, and selective fine linework at focal materials. Preserve the reference's actual visible contour density and surface treatment. No painterly blending and no glossy 3D.
Composition/framing: preserve Image 1; square format; keep every principal subject safely inside the frame.
Constraints: no added focal objects or characters; no unrequested fire; no dramatic rim light; no text, logo, watermark, decorative frame, or border.
